# hibira_livechat_team (Resource)

A team of agents in a [Hibira Live Chat](https://chat.hibira.io) workspace: conversations can be sent to a team, and routing rules and the widget's topics can name it. Teams are on the Team and Business plans; a workspace has at most 20. Import with `<workspace_id>/<team id>`. Uses the provider's API token, which needs write access (and delete access to remove things) and an owner or admin of the workspace as its owner. Works on every plan; a feature the workspace's plan doesn't include is refused with a message naming the plan that has it. Needs Hibira server v0.2.166 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The provider's API token works in the Live Chat workspaces its owner is
# an owner or admin of: GET https://api.hibira.io/live-chat/v1/workspaces lists them.
resource "hibira_livechat_team" "billing" {
  workspace_id = "ws_0123456789abcdef"
  name         = "Billing"
  agents       = ["mei@example.com", "kai@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agents` (Set of String) The members' emails. Each must already be an agent in the workspace (invite people in Live Chat's Settings › Team first).
- `name` (String) The team's name, shown to agents (and to visitors when a topic names it).
- `workspace_id` (String) The Live Chat workspace's ID (`ws_...`, in Live Chat's Settings, or `GET /v1/workspaces`). Changing it makes a new one there.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The team's ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hibira_livechat_team.billing ws_0123456789abcdef/team_0123456789
```
